description: This file defines a repository class 'CategoryRepository' that interfaces with a network API to fetch various categorized content items and banner URLs for an Android TV application. It handles network errors gracefully by providing fallback sample data. The class uses suspend functions for asynchronous API calls and maps data transfer objects to UI content models.

classes.name: CategoryRepository
classes.description: Repository class that provides methods to fetch categorized content and banners, wrapping network API calls with error handling and fallback to sample data.

methods.name: fetchBanners
methods.description: Fetches banner URLs from API; returns a Result containing a list of non-blank banner URLs or an empty list on error.

methods.name: sampleItemsFor
methods.description: Generates a list of sample ContentItem objects for a given category, used as fallback data.

methods.name: fetchCategory
methods.description: Fetches content items for a specific category from API; on failure, returns sample fallback items.
